archetype: The Performance Pro / Deep Graphite Developer Tool

fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace

layouts.topbar: h-14 bg-[#14171D] border-b border-[#282E3A] px-4 flex items-center justify-between

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a full-stack AI coding orchestration app called 'ProjectPilot' using FastAPI (backend) and React + Tailwind + Lucide Icons + Recharts + Sonner (frontend).

Use a left sidebar with navigation links: Dashboard, Projects, Master Plan, Delegation Plan, Task Queue, Live Preview Workspace, Verification Results, Git Branches & Diffs, Cost & Usage, Activity Logs, Settings.
Top bar MUST show current active project, repository, git branch (e.g. preview/task-104), and orchestration status badge.
Strictly enforce the 4 Model Tiers: Local (Teal), Cheap (Sky Blue), Expensive (Purple/Violet), Human Review (Amber).

The core workflow MUST follow: Project Brief -> Master Implementation Plan -> AI Delegation Plan -> Task Queue -> Model Assignment -> Code Edit Request -> Temporary Preview Branch -> Live Application Preview (iframe/mock runner) -> Verification Checks (Lint/Type/Build) -> Diff Review -> Human Approval -> Git Commit / Merge.
The application must NEVER autonomously merge or deploy without explicit human approval action.

Include a rich stateful backend (Python FastAPI) with endpoints for projects, tasks, master plan, delegation rules, code diffs, verification runs, live preview session status, usage metrics, and logs.
Include live mock actions: 'Run AI Edit Request', 'Execute Verification Checks', 'Switch Model Tier', 'Approve & Merge Branch', 'Reject Edit', 'Launch Live Preview'.

Every key interactive element, button, badge, input, tab, and card MUST contain explicit 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='approve-diff-button', data-testid='model-tier-select', data-testid='run-verification-btn').
Use JetBrains Mono font for code blocks, IDs, Git hashes, diff view lines, terminal commands, and model metadata.
Avoid high-contrast full gradients. Stick to deep graphite (#0D0F12), slate surfaces (#14171D), crisp 1px borders (#282E3A), electric blue accents (#38BDF8), and subtle status hues.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: No transparent backgrounds on dropdowns or overlays; use dark elevated slate (#1C2028) with backdrop-blur.
Use Sonner for toast notifications upon approving code edits, running verifications, or toggling model tiers.
Provide clear interactive feedback with state changes, loading spinners, and progress indicators during mock AI generation or lint/build runs.
Maintain responsive layout with dense IDE-like split panes, expandable sections, and tabs for Live Preview vs Diff Review.
Ensure APCA / WCAG accessibility for dark backgrounds with high contrast light gray text (#E2E8F0) and visible focus rings.
